review.notes: Whole-document word-level diff of the OCR markdown against extracted text from all 23 physical PDF pages; physical p.1 was rendered at 300 dpi to verify the correspondence footnote. Code fences are absent and all tables (Tables 1-9), figure captions (Figures 1-18), the affiliation footnote and both appendix sections are present. Most diff gaps are page-header repeats, figure-internal labels covered by embedded figure images (action-key strips, frame strips, radar-chart axes), and math-notation ordering, none of which lose reader-visible content.
